title: German Pediatric Hemophilia Research Database
brief_summary: The German Pediatric Hemophilia Research Database will collect data on the prophylactic and therapeutic use of factor concentrates, complications, outcome measures (joint scores, QoL) and living circumstances in newly diagnosed children with hemophilia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* hemophilia A or B
* FVIII/FIX \<1% to 25%
* informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* no consent
study_population: All children between 0 and 18 yrs diagnosed with hemophilia A or B (FVIII/FIX \< 1% to 25%) from 01.01.2017.
